lines.en: label makotospring2:
The next five minutes are agonizingly long as I have to suffer the full force of what it means to be the main character.
Despite the screaming, which can most assuredly be heard from the halls, no one comes to the rescue.
No one leaves their room at all — because they’re only there when I need them to be or when the SCRIPT calls for it.
And right now, that script only calls for pain — frightened yelps as the gazelle bleeds out before me while I realize I have never been a lion at all.
I have been a poacher.
And I have gravely injured this animal while hunting a far more elusive, far more valuable one.
There are gazelles everywhere out here. Who am I supposed to sell this one to?
It isn’t worth it to waste another bullet. But I was born with the burden of guilt — so I’ve nothing left to do but sit and wait as the last bit of life drains from its body.
scene makotofindsher1
: Oh, wow. That is a lot.
I suppose I was exaggerating a bit. I’m sure that comes as no surprise, though.
Clearly, Miku isn’t going to die from this. She just might have some trouble sitting down for a while.
Or worse yet, this experience will add one more item to her growing list of traumas and, after today, she won’t want to have sex with me at all as it will only bring back bad memories.
: Ngh!!!! Ngh!!!! It still hurts!!! The pain...won’t stop!!!!
: What now? What are we supposed to do?
: Miku, do you think you need to go to the hospital?
: I don’t know! I think my vagina’s broken!
: Well, at least her sense of humor is intact.
: I’m not joking! I seriously think it’s broken!
: Is that even possible?...
: I guess that depends on what she means by “broken.” You likely just tore something. Other than what you very obviously tore by deflowering her, I mean.
: I’m not gonna have to get friggin’ vagina stitches, am I?
: Miku, do you remember how long it took for you to stop bleeding when you scraped your knee on the pavement playing soccer?
: This ain’t my friggin’ knee we’re talkin’ about, Makoto! Sensei stuck it in my friggin’ cervix!
scene makotofindsher2
: He might have touched it, but he didn’t stick it in your cervix, Miku. What I’m trying to get at is that this always happens when you bleed. Your body just...doesn’t clot well, I guess?
: So what I’m hearin’ is this didn’t happen to you?!
: Not like that, no. But...you’re probably fine?
: Probably?! You don’t know?!
scene makotofindsher3
: I mean...my mom might? But calling her about this would be...well...
: She might have some things to say to you about it once you settle down.
: MNGGGHHH! I don’t even care anymore! She can talk about whatever she wants if she knows how to make this stop!
scene makotofindsher4
: Sensei, what do you- can you not look like that, please? It’s not like you killed her. You just...may have broken her vagina.
: AAAAGGGHH! I KNEW IT! IT IS BROKEN!
scene makotofindsher5
: Miku, I’m going to give you three options: wait out the pain with me, go to the hospital, or see if there’s something my mom can do.
: Mmmmngh! I don’t know! Just pick one for me!
: I think you should call Maki.
scene makotofindsher6
: I think so too. Especially if the pain is as bad as Miku says it is. You know what that means though, right?
: Yeah. I’ll tell her it was me.
scene makotofindsher7
: Wha- are you out of your fucking mind?! Absolutely not! It means you have to get the hell out of here before she finds out it was you!
: I’ll make up a story! I don’t want you gettin’ in trouble because’a me, Sensei! That ain’t fair to you! You didn’t do nothin’ wrong!
: ...Are you serious right now?
: Yes! You wanted me to handle this, didn’t you? This is me handling it. Now, get the hell out of here so I can ask my mom about how to fix Miku’s vagina.
: I’m sorry, Sensei...I’m really sorry! I tried to endure it, but I just-
scene makotofindsher8
: Miku, shh. Just try to calm down and hold still. I’ll find something to try and stop the bleeding.
: Oh god, you ain’t gonna try to plug it up, are ya?! Ain’t no way I’m puttin’ anythin’ else in there right now! Not happenin’! No, ma’am!
: I’m not going to plug it up, I’m-
scene makotofindsher9
: Sensei, why are you still here?! Leave!
scene bedroom_night
I make it back home in two pieces after stealing one from someone else.
A successful hunt, I do say. But the bounty, while it sustains me, is one that I can not lay upon the table and dig into with a fork and knife.
I hold in my hands a pair of small horns, plucked from the skull of an animal. They’ll look lovely upon my mantle beside the countless others I have stolen.
These ones will require some work, though. There’s flesh still at the roots. And bright, red blood drips from where they were removed.
It stains my hands and my floorboards, but it’s nothing that the grease of an elbow or an ammonia cocktail won’t take care of.
I set them down and I wait for my phone to ring.
It finally does.
: I have good news, Sensei.
: Miku’s vagina is not broken.
: Maki was able to help?...
: By driving her to the hospital, yes.
: Wha-
: Just as a precaution, though.
: The doctors said the bleeding would have eventually stopped on its own. But they gave her some pills to help with the pain and told her to take it easy for a while.
: She’s now currently being lectured on safe sex. So in that regard, I guess a little good did manage to come out of this.
: Do you feel guilty?
: It’s kind of hard not to when it’s literally my fault.
: Just be glad it happened the way it did and not with someone no one knew about. I suppose it’d be hard finding anyone like that at this point, though.
: Listen...
: I know it’s late. But would you want to meet up?
: I’m not really in the mood to have more sex, Makoto.
: Really? Because, according to Miku, you never even finished. Unless you’re saying you finished yourself off when you got home.
: Makoto-
: I’m sorry...That was a joke. A poorly timed one, I’ll add.
: But Sensei, I do want to see you. And not for sex either. We don’t always have to do that, you know?
: I just don’t want this sitting with you. Especially now that you’re actually an active participant in my life again after feeling sorry for yourself for so long.
: So...how about we meet in the park?
: The park?...
: The one near the school.
: That’s where everything started today. That’s where I met up with Miku.
: Heh...
: It seems like everything comes full circle nowadays, doesn’t it?
: I’m still at the hospital right now, but I think we’ll be leaving soon. Can you maybe meet me there in...an hour?
: Are you sure you don’t want to stay with Miku and make sure she’s okay?
: She’s fine, Sensei. And extremely embarrassed right now, so it’ll probably be good for me to leave her alone and let her wallow in shame for a bit.
scene black
: Okay.
: We’ll meet in an hour.
scene clearnightsky
I can’t help but notice how soft my hands are now that I’ve washed the blood off of them.
They were all I washed, though.
I’ve been afraid to take my pants off ever since putting them back on in Miku’s room as I know that glancing down at my weapon will do naught but remind me of the beast it killed tonight.
Maybe I’m making a bigger deal out of this than it needs to be?
That’s how Makoto’s making it sound.
That’s how the me inside of me is making it sound.
And I’m sure that’s how Miku will make it sound too once she’s all better.
But...
To me, it feels like an omen.
To me, it feels like the universe telling me that my favorite hiding place isn’t safe anymore.
And that’s all the more terrifying since I’ve known I’ve been sleeping in the cave of a black bear ever since I began life here.
I didn’t think it would ever wake up.
And now all I can do is worry that something will bite into my neck next.
: Thanks for coming.
scene makotofindsher10
: How do you feel?
: Not so great, to tell you the truth.
: Yeah. You don’t look so great either.
: Are you mad at me?
: Do you want me to be mad at you?
: Kind of.
: You want me to lecture you? Try and talk you out of repeating this same bad decision in the future when we both know that will do nothing to stop you?
: Kind of...
: Okay. I can do that.
scene makotofindsher11
: You made a very irresponsible decision tonight, Sensei.
: The doctor did not hesitate to comment on how Miku’s body was very much not meant to withstand “whatever it was” she attempted to put in there. And I’m sure that wasn’t lost on you.

: You knew the damage you could potentially inflict on her. And while it would have been hard to guess just how much she’d bleed as a result of that due to a preexisting condition, it was still dangerous.
: I get being caught up in the moment, but surely you must have noticed that you didn’t fit...correct?
: Yeah, but...it’s never been like that before. I knew it would hurt, I just didn’t think it would hurt her that much.
scene makotofindsher12
: I’m sure it didn’t help that Miku isn’t good with blood. I imagine that seeing what you’d done to her was a larger contributing factor in the panic that ensued than the pain itself.
: But what’s done is done. And now you know to be more careful.
scene makotofindsher13
: A condom would have helped as well. The added lubrication certainly wouldn’t have been a negative.
: Is she mad at me? Now that she’s started to...calm down, I guess?
scene makotofindsher14
: She feels guilty. And ashamed. What she imagined would be a special moment between you two ended in a trip to the hospital and you not getting any amount of pleasure at all.
: So no, she’s not mad at you. She’s mad at herself. And this will probably sound crazy, but I think most of us would feel the same way in her position.
: That’s because most of you are delusional.
scene makotofindsher15

: Of course her body wasn’t meant to “withstand” me. It’s not fully developed yet. I’ve just been getting lucky so far. But all of you are so blinded by desire to be with me that you flat-out don’t care.
: You’ll let me do anything I want to you because you think that’s the only way to my heart. And the worst fucking part is that you’re probably right.
: So is this just the burden I need to bear from now on in order to keep feeling human? To know that something could go wrong at any second and I could severely physically damage you?
: You realize that all of that has to do with the fact that you have a gigantic penis and not the fact that you’re just older, right?
: Did that make too much sense?
: Do you want me to just agree and call you a bad guy for wanting to fuck high school girls? Because that’s not unique to you, Sensei. It’s a top-selling genre at the porn shop for a reason.
: But there’s a difference between porn and reality, Makoto. Fetishizing that is completely different from participating in it and I know you know that because you’re not an idiot.
: You’re right. I’m not an idiot.
: But I’m also willing to acknowledge the fact that the majority of girls you know can literally not grow up here.
: But that’s-
: Besides, its a person’s mental maturity that dictates just when it is and isn’t okay to sleep with them. Which isn’t doing you any favors when it comes to girls like Miku...but think about it.
: If it was just you and me for a million years...spending time together...getting to know one another...and maturing mentally...would it still be wrong to fuck me?
: Would you deprive me of experiencing everything life has to offer because of an arbitrary number that means nothing in the face of where and when we are?
: At what point is it okay to throw that out the window? How many thousands of years need to pass before that line is drawn?
: Hold on...
scene makotofindsher16
: You’re not as evil as you think, Sensei. You’re really not.
: Expecting you to just keep your hands off of all of us indefinitely until we literally manage to restore the flow of time is so unreasonable that anyone would be on your side if they knew.
: But they don’t...So you just need to keep believing you’re Satan himself while time ticks infinitely onward and every single one of us stays exactly the same.
: I can only imagine how hard that is for you.
scene makotofindsher17
: And, trust me — I’ve been thinking about it a lot. I’ve had plenty of time lately.
scene makotofindsher18
: Being sincere about any of this is hard now. Like, I had no idea just how much of an impact time had on morality until I experienced being stuck like this.
: When there’s clear direction...and consequences...all of that stuff makes so much sense. Bad decisions steer reality into the wrong direction and good ones steer it into the right one.
: Taking those consequences out of the equation just turns life into a sandbox. It’s a place where, no matter what we choose to do, we all wind up back at the start.
: So there can be no right or wrong anymore. We’re all dogs chained to poles. And we’re hungry, so we’ll eat anything that’s thrown at us. Even if we know it isn’t safe.
: Fill your belly. Go to sleep. Wake up in the sun. That’s it. That’s all we have now.
: Which is why I can only pretend to be mad at you.
scene makotofindsher19
: And why I don’t think you’re evil anymore.
A cat looks on. I have seen it before.
Its eyes are like marbles. Its fur like the snow.
: But if time moved normally-
: If everything went back to the way it’s supposed to be...
: And I was no different from who I am now-
: Would I be evil then?
: Why does it matter? That’s just a hypothetical.
: What’s real is where and when we are right now. And even in this world, where time is as infinite as the sky-
: Trying to figure out answers like that is a waste of it.
: Do you feel any better now?
: Yeah?...
: But I...don’t think I’m...supposed to.
: Stop caring about what you are or aren’t supposed to do and just enjoy this gift we’ve been given.
: We can rewrite right and wrong here. And if the world was perfect the way it was before...I don’t think we’d have ever made it here at all.
: Maybe that’s what we’re supposed to do. Really start over. Make a new world.
: I love you so much.
scene black
: How lucky I am to wake up somewhere I can do that forever.
scene makotofindsher20
I feel at peace for the first time in months.
The cool air from the mouth of spring encircles me as I stare off into the night.
I don’t know when exactly Makoto left-
But I think that’s the point.
scene black
If T is for time or trees and threes then maybe my life isn’t mine.
If Heaven and Hell and the space in between can’t be seen then I think I’ll be fine.
I won’t ever get old, I won’t ever die young, I’ll do nothing but live and let love.
But when living and loving are things I don’t know-
What exactly does my life consist of?
